Resolves #4529

Updates `Neo.component.wrapper.GoogleMaps#onMarkerStoreLoad` to pass `mapId: id` to `Neo.main.addon.GoogleMaps.destroyMarkers` and spread `...(item.toJSON?.() || item)` when re-adding markers from `markerStore`, and updates `Neo.main.addon.GoogleMaps#destroyMarkers` to accept `data.mapId || data.id` so removed store records clear their map markers.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit suite `test/playwright/unit/component/GoogleMapsMarkerRemovals.spec.mjs`) → L1 required (all acceptance criteria covered by unit tests).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/component/GoogleMapsMarkerRemovals.spec.mjs` (`passes mapId to destroyMarkers and serializes Record fields when markerStore loads or removes records`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Serializes `Neo.data.Record` instances via `...(item.toJSON?.() || item)` in `onMarkerStoreLoad` because `markerStore` uses `autoInitRecords: true` by default and `Record` field getters reside on `Record.prototype` rather than own enumerable properties.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required; covered by unit tests in CI.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:**

    - `src/component/wrapper/GoogleMaps.mjs` at `dev`: `onMarkerStoreLoad` (l.281) passes `{appName, id, windowId}` to `destroyMarkers`, and spreads `...item` into `addMarker`.
    - `src/main/addon/GoogleMaps.mjs` at `dev`: `destroyMarkers` reads `data.mapId` (l.157). `addMarker` keys markers as `me.markers[mapId][data.id]`, so there `data.id` means the marker.
    - `src/data/RecordFactory.mjs`: `toJSON()` (l.336) returns a clone of the record's data. Fields are prototype getters, which an object spread skips.

*   **Expected Solution Shape:**

    - Items are serialized through `toJSON` when they are Records, and plain objects pass through.

    - **Test isolation:** the real wrapper against a mocked main-thread addon, covering the initial load and a removal.
*   **Patch Verdict:** It matches on the wrapper. It also widens the addon's contract with `data.mapId || data.id`; see the challenge below.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge (non-blocking):** the addon's new fallback, `mapId = data.mapId || data.id`, has no consumer. `destroyMarkers` has exactly one caller, this wrapper, and it now passes `mapId`. The fallback also gives `id` a second meaning on the same addon, because `addMarker` reads `data.id` as the *marker* id. I'd drop the fallback and the `[data.id]` JSDoc line, and keep the documented `data.mapId` as the one key.
